description: HAL USART2 to an HC-05 Bluetooth module: AT dialogue at 38400 (EN held high by a pull-up at power-up), AT+RESET into data mode at 9600, 'hello phone' and an echo of every line from the paired phone; report on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. USART2 PA2 -> HC-05 RXD, PA3 <- HC-05 TXD; PB0 -> HC-05 EN with a 10 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V (PB0 input after reset, so EN is high at power-up = AT mode); PB1 <- STATE (input pull-down); USART1 PA9 115200 8N1 report. After reset: 'HC-05 test
', 120 ms start-up wait, then up to 3 'AT' at 38400 8N1 (20 ms answer timeout each). No answer: 'no answer from the HC-05 (EN high at power-up? 38400 8N1?)
' and the core sleeps. Else 'AT ok (try N)
' and one report line '<cmd> -> <answer>' for AT+VERSION?, AT+NAME=OHMLET, AT+NAME?, AT+UART=9600,0,0, AT+UART?, AT+ROLE?, AT+PSWD? (answer lines joined by a space, e.g. 'AT+NAME? -> +NAME:OHMLET OK'); then PB0 driven low, 'AT+RESET -> OK', USART2 re-initialised at 9600 8N1, wait up to 1 s for STATE high: 'phone connected (STATE high after T ms)
' (T about 100 ms: the module restart) or 'no phone (STATE low)
'. To the phone: 'hello phone
'; every line the phone sends is answered with 'you said: <line>
' and reported as 'phone: <line>
'.

circuit: HC-05 module: not placed on this bench (the checks runner cannot place it; the AT dialogue and the phone link are covered by tests/devices/comm-firmware.test.ts)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

boot.USART1:
HC-05 test
no answer from the HC-05 (EN high at power-up? 38400 8N1?)
